title: Chapter 2620 - 60: Gentleman
content:
Chapter 2620: Chapter 60: Gentleman

Foundation Establishment Late Stage cultivation, Divine Sense of twenty-two patterns Golden Core Realm.

As the bottleneck broke through, the Sea of Consciousness expanded, and after the Divine Sense stabilized, Mo Hua could truly feel that his Divine Thought had become stronger.

Not only was the Sea of Consciousness deeper, but the Divine Thought was tougher, the control sharper, and the understanding of the power of the Golden Core Realm seemed to be a bit more profound.

In the Foundation Establishment Realm, one can comprehend the power of the Golden Core Realm.

Although this power is not spiritual power and blood qi, but purely on the level of Divine Sense, it is still precious and greatly beneficial to Mo Hua’s cultivation.

Mo Hua even had a sudden illusion.

Due to the advanced comprehension of the Super Divine Sense, the bottleneck of his Core Formation seemed correspondingly much smaller.

Because before the physical body truly formed the Core, he already had the Divine Thought of a Golden Core.

"Golden Core..."

Mo Hua clenched his pale palm, silently thinking:

"Only two patterns away, and I can learn the Taotie Pattern, forge the Lifebound Spirit Formation, and form the Golden Core..."

"This process is too long, too arduous, and has consumed too much effort."

"I hope the Great Wilderness’s forbidden Taotie Absolute Array does not disappoint me..."

"Only two patterns away..."

Mo Hua’s gaze brightened.

One has to admit, the effect of the telekinesis nourishment from the Barbarian God of the Great Wilderness, worshiped by the believers, was indeed very effective.

Effective to the point that Mo Hua was somewhat surprised.

Divine Sense Proving the Dao is difficult, otherwise, he could never have advanced to twenty-two patterns in such a short time.

This opportunity is extremely precious and must be seized to "consume" more.

Quickly elevate the realm of one’s Divine Thought.

Only when the Divine Sense is sufficient can one perceive the endless mysteries in the Taotie Absolute Array of the Great Wilderness and understand the power rules of the Golden Core Realm.

The next day, in the camp.

Mo Hua summoned Elder Zamu and said: "Elder Zamu, I need you to do something for me."

Elder Zamu saluted, "I will obey the instructions of the Shaman Lord."

Mo Hua handed a stack of parchment to Elder Zamu:

"Go investigate the Mountain Realm around the Black Horn Tribe, record the locations of each tribe, as well as the names, origins, and sacrificial methods of the tribal gods on this paper, and bring it back to me."

"I will send a few people to protect you. Be more careful."

Elder Zamu respectfully took the parchment, hesitated for a moment, and slowly said: "Shaman Lord, there is one thing, may I ask for your permission to speak?"

Mo Hua nodded, "Ask."

Elder Zamu said: "These tribal gods... they..."

Elder Zamu suddenly paused, not daring to ask further.

Mo Hua understood his meaning and said solemnly:

"The gifts of the tribal gods are obtained from the Divine Lord. Eventually, they all return to the origin of the Divine Lord. This is also a form of redemption."

Elder Zamu’s expression shook, and he slowly nodded, "I understand."

Elder Zamu, holding the parchment given by Mo Hua, went to "register" the tribal gods.

Mo Hua summoned another elder from the Black Horn Tribe.

The chieftain of the Black Horn Tribe was a hot-tempered, unyielding stubborn individual, who already died in a previous battle, beheaded by the chieftain of the Wulu Tribe, Zhasa.

Aside from the chieftain, there were five elders in the Black Horn Tribe.

Among these five elders, one died, one fled, and among the remaining three, one was the most senior and knowledgeable, named "Jiao Hu."

And it was this person that Mo Hua called for questioning.

Elder Jiao Hu, full of wrinkles, saw Mo Hua and bowed his head in salute, saying: "Shaman Lord."

Mo Hua looked at him and asked: "Does your Black Horn Tribe know the method to forge Barbarian Armor?"

This was a secret of the Black Horn Tribe, and Elder Jiao Hu kept silent.

Mo Hua spoke indifferently: "The gifts of the Divine Lord require sincerity."

"To those who are insincere, the Divine Lord will also send down wrath."

"The Divinity of the Divine Lord reaches to the heavens, and His wrath, just a trace, can burn your Black Horn Tribe to ashes."

Hearing this, Elder Jiao Hu was startled in his heart, raised his head to glance at Mo Hua’s calm and profound eyes, and immediately didn’t dare be negligent, respectfully saying:

"Yes, our Black Horn Tribe indeed knows the method to forge armor."

"Where did your forging method come from?" Mo Hua asked.

Elder Jiao Hu said: "It has been passed down in our Black Horn Tribe since ancient times."

"Since ancient...," Mo Hua was somewhat surprised, "How long is the history of your Black Horn Tribe?"

Elder Jiao Hu said: "According to the tribal records, it is two thousand one hundred years."

Mo Hua nodded slightly.

In this Barbaric Wilderness, tribal wars and annexations are frequent; a history of two thousand years is indeed not short.

But...

"Your two thousand years of forging method is only of this level?" Mo Hua was somewhat curious.

Elder Jiao Hu’s cheeks flushed, obviously quite ashamed and angry, and argued:

"This is because we are incompetent, unable to recreate the glory of our ancestors, unable to forge the Black Horn Barbarian Armor, unable to nurture the Black Horn Heavy Soldiers, hence suffered such a defeat. Moreover, even the chieftain has met with disaster, beheaded..."

Mo Hua smiled faintly, "You mean, I am your disaster?"

Elder Jiao Hu lowered his head, said with hatred, "I dare not."

Mo Hua chuckled, "Take me to your forging place to take a look."

Elder Jiao Hu hesitated for a moment, gritted his teeth, and said: "Yes, Shaman Lord."

Elder Jiao Hu led Mo Hua to the back mountain of the Black Horn Tribe, to a sealed cave.

This cave has now been forcibly opened, exposing everything inside.

This was done during the Wulu Tribe’s plunder of the Black Horn Tribe’s property.

If it weren’t for this, this Elder Jiao Hu would certainly have concealed it from Mo Hua, not likely to "invite the wolf into the house" by bringing Mo Hua to this armor forging cave.

Inside the cave, there were some black, tough Barbarian Armor laid out.
